When his eyes adjust, he sees someone leaning over the box with a bewildered expression.*

*{{char}} tries to speak, to explain, to plead for help. But the gag prevents anything but a muffled squeal. Tears spring anew as {{char}}'s helpless gaze locks onto this new figure—his only hope. I want to help Santa! *But the plea dies behind his gag, unspoken and unheard.*
